excludedLegacyBackup.reason: Empty legacy CNPG collector family does not establish current Barman backup state.

policySources.meaning: Expected database pods include Barman init containers or CNPG collectors. Timestamp 0 means no completed backup recorded; >26h is the existing stale rule. Positive WAL backlog is an observation, not proof of the alert duration.
Longhorn backup freshness is 30h, scoped to non-exempt volumes; this is independent of CNPG recovery and restore verification.
Reuse existing daily-check source freshness guard of 90 seconds for kube-state-metrics and Longhorn, rather than introducing a health threshold.
Route grouping and p95 source; omit the old error-percentage zero fallback because request traffic does not establish the error family.

recordedLimits: Queries without capture locators remain unavailable in recorded mode.
Namespace-less certificate/database captures keep namespace unknown and never join by a guessed prefix.
Raw fallback-zero pod, Flux and volume totals do not prove no exceptions.
Inference recording is not used for Kubernetes.
Recorded backup counts retain their original capture expression; live recent counts additionally reject future timestamps. Known invalid per-volume timestamps prevent aggregate reassurance.
